plan.title: Extend Closed RFQ by One Hour

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed RFQ; prepared-state cases must begin from its summary.
Enable eRFX projects for the RFQ event flow.
Use the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case configuration.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen permission setting.
Open the RFQ stage before accessing its responses and settings.
Reach the RFQ Responses view where the stage Settings menu is available.
Select the one-hour Increase Event Time preset, save it, and verify the event end time increased by one hour and the window closed.
